title: Power to prohibit use of water from certain sources

versions.Latest:
87. Power to prohibit use of water from certain sources.—

—   The Panchayat may, 
during epidemics on receipt of a certificate from any medical officer of the Government 
stating that such action is desirable, summarily by notice prohibit the use of water from 
any source to which the public have access. Such notice shall be served by putting up a 
copy thereof near the source of water supply stating the number of days during which 
such prohibition shall last. The Panchayat may from time to time extend or modify the 
period of prohibition without the production of a further certificate;
